faq.q: Is GST Road a good location to buy a plot?
faq.a: Yes — strong connectivity to Chennai's southern suburbs, industrial hubs and the airport supports appreciation potential through infrastructure growth and residential demand. CMDA/DTCP approvals reduce legal risk.

faq.q: What is the average price of a plot on GST Road?
faq.a: Prices vary by location, size, and road frontage — consult local listings or developers like OmShakthy Homes for current rates.

faq.q: Are plots on GST Road a good investment?
faq.a: Yes — the area benefits from ongoing infrastructure upgrades, sustained rental demand near employment centres, and steady urban expansion. Clean approvals ease financing and resale.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying a plot on GST Road?
faq.a: Stamp duty follows Tamil Nadu's prevailing rates as a percentage of sale or market value, whichever is higher — request an exact duty and registration cost breakdown from your seller or legal advisor.

faq.q: How do I verify a plot on GST Road is free of legal disputes?
faq.a: Obtain an encumbrance certificate, check title deeds, verify there are no pending litigations, and ensure approvals match documents. Engaging a qualified property lawyer provides additional verification.

faq.q: Can I get a home loan for buying a plot on GST Road?
faq.a: Yes — loans are available from banks and NBFCs, though criteria differ from flat loans. Lenders require clear title and approvals, and loan-to-value ratios may be lower.

faq.q: What amenities are typically available in gated plot communities on GST Road?
faq.a: Internal paved roads, street lighting, underground drainage, reliable water supply, and perimeter fencing — many also include landscaped areas, storm-water drains, and power distribution boxes.
